Darren,

Thank you for such a prompt response. When looking in the Volume Management, I saw volume scheduled in ENA and ENA Upstream.  I actualized in ENA  and I heard that Blue Dolphin will go to upstream starting July production month.  Could you confirm which entity for the month of June?  

Thanks!

Antoinette

Can you please inform the appropriate person in settlements to handle those deals?

Thanks.
